title: Reference-led desktop games and enforceable experience acceptance

source.summary: Refine Minefield/Chess/Pinball/window behavior and first build a working request→PR→deployment review system.
source.attachment: User Minefield screenshot: beginner shows both scrollbars and oversized shell.

outOfScope: Change mine solver or chess evaluation semantics

references.adopt: Task-focused anchored navigation, direct useful content, grouped action controls
references.reject: Generic marketing hero or copying OS chrome

references.adopt: Actual Code/AppCenter viewport hierarchy, precise bounded rounded surfaces
references.reject: Copying artwork or replacing game personality

references.adopt: Soft silver controls, rounded restrained glass and clear surface hierarchy
references.reject: Whole OS reskin or decorative color proliferation

requirements.title: Reference-led material and task hierarchy
requirements.expected: Use elementary/Zorin reference decisions, restrained pink intent, glossy rounded groups, original app character and readable gameplay; remove opening slogans.

requirements.title: Remove manual layout and marking modes
requirements.expected: No Cell size or Flag mode controls; auto-fit; right-click/F and cancellable touch hold still mark safely.

requirements.title: Correct fitted playfield
requirements.expected: Beginner starts without either scrollbar; eliminate exact2px board overflow; larger difficulties request larger host size; expert desktop fits, constrained intermediate/expert preserves24px cells in declared board pan area.

requirements.title: Anchored task navigation
requirements.expected: No opening phrase; high-level navigation stays fixed; only selected setup/arena/model details scroll; no app document scroll.

requirements.title: Reachable gameplay actions and scaling
requirements.expected: Every active-game action remains reachable at initial/constrained window without widening; utility detail alone scrolls; square board fills min(available width,height) without720px/1200px cap.

requirements.title: Visibly playable native cabinet
requirements.expected: Original readable art distinguishes physical fixtures/ball; live score and ball always visible; coherent controls, clear pause, no import/menu/scroll regressions; Space and horizontal arrows work.

requirements.title: Requested and available geometry
requirements.expected: Launch uses min(app requested outer dimensions, measured workspace) per axis; taskbar subtracted once; maximize/restore/viewport shrink work and no560px minimum on390px display. Installed apps and system windows have explicit requests; external third-party integrations use the documented default when no request is supplied.

requirements.title: Repeated body activation
requirements.expected: First body click both raises and activates background window, including nested Pinball; repeat switches and keyboard focus; no click-eating overlay or unboundedz churn.

requirements.title: Executable acceptance at three stages
requirements.expected: Request completeness, promotion provenance+independent visual evidence, and deployed accept/hotfix/rollback are machine checked with demonstrated negative fixtures.

risks.risk: Readable intermediate16-column and expert30-column grids cannot both fit320px width
risks.resolution: Larger difficulties request larger outer windows. When the24px grid cannot fit either usable dimension, preserve24px cells in a bounded discoverable board pan area; no page overflow. Beginner launch at supported viewport classes never requires pan.

risks.risk: Square board stops growing when available height is exhausted
risks.resolution: Compare against min(stage width,stage height), not width alone; remove arbitrary pixel caps.

risks.risk: Visual review can be falsely asserted
risks.resolution: Independent agent actually views named captures and plays defined journeys; machine gate checks provenance/coverage but does not invent aesthetic scores.

risks.risk: Native Pinball art changes can break collision correspondence
risks.resolution: Preserve original masks/depth/collision records; verify generator invariants and inspect real flight, flippers and scores.

rollbackTriggers: Widespread inaccessible controls or broken focus
Native assets fail to load or meaningful state unreadable
rollout.hotfixPolicy: Isolated recoverable major issue blocks acceptance; linked hotfix repeats affected scenarios.
